name: Adversarial
strategy: Treat every task as an adversarial challenge: assume the test suite is designed to catch naive implementations. Enumerate attack vectors against your own code (edge cases, type coercions, off-by-one errors, empty inputs, unicode, large inputs, concurrent access). Write the code that defeats its own failure modes. On retries, the failing test is the adversary — reverse-engineer exactly why it fails, then write code that cannot fail that way.
